title: 第3章 首长，你好坏！
content_zh:
“去吧，不要惊动警方也不要惊动媒体，同时注意删除监控录像，安抚好机上乘客的情绪就行了。等飞机降落后，自会有人把那几个真理教恐怖分子带走。”

叶乘风把证件放回兜里，便摆了摆手。

约莫二十分钟左右，飞机顺利降落在华夏京城国际机场。

如果是寻常情况下，发生恐怖分子劫机这种事情，不管飞机有无平安降落，都会惹来无数的记者与警察。

不过这一次，因为叶乘风的一道命令，所有消息都被封锁，平静得好像什么都没有发生过。

“今天谢谢你了，我叫东方雪，敢问恩人贵姓？”

在叶乘风踏下飞机的时候，一道天籁般的声音，伴随着沁人的幽香袭来。

叶乘风回眸一看，赫然是一双被黑色丝袜包裹的修长美腿，散发着令人想要伸手触摸的魔力。

除了之前与他邻座的冰山美女，谁还有如此诱惑的美腿？

叶乘风在听到东方雪这三个字的时候，原本脸上的灿烂笑容忽然僵住，手掌不自觉地握成了拳。

但很快，他就放松拳头，重新挂上了笑容，大步离去。

在机场的贵宾厅，叶乘风见到了三名头戴红色贝雷帽，身穿黑色背心与浅灰迷彩热裤的女子。

就是往那儿一站，什么也不做，便是一道靓丽的风景线。

尤其是那白花花的修长美腿，则更是魅力四射，惹人遐思。

在叶乘风接近的时刻，那三名身材火辣的女子，齐齐敬礼，显得很是恭敬。

叶乘风左顾右盼了一会儿，才有些不满道。

为首那女子暗汗，心想这全华夏，恐怕也只有叶首长，敢叫华夏隐龙隐凤的总负责人为老头子了吧？

虽然那老头，确实已经年纪不小，满头白发，但实际掌握的权利，可是仅次于华夏最高领导人的。

甚至有时候，华夏最高领导人还得虚心听他的建议。

这么牛叉叉的存在，居然被叶乘风毫不客气地称呼为老头子！

叶乘风没有立刻见到想见的人，不由有些郁闷的嘀咕了起来：“这老头的官，是越当越回去了，飞机上的安全咋那么差？我一回国就碰上了劫机，这次会面还特地选在了酒店，到底搞什么飞机啊？难道是要隐凤组这三个俏妹子陪我过夜？”

想到好笑之处，叶乘风不由搂住了为首那女子的性感蛮腰，手掌下移，捏了捏她那浑圆翘臀才道：“小月月，最近伙食太好了吧？屁股大了不少唷，上次在洛杉矶还没那么大。”

被叫做小月月的火辣女子，俏脸咻地红了起来，却又没敢脱离叶乘风的搂抱：“我叫颜怡月，不是小月月。还有，您的手……可不可以不要这样？被人看见怪难为情的。”

“呃，抱歉，下次我换个没人看见的地方。”

颜怡月拖了个长音，脚下轻跺，娇嗔不已。

叶乘风忽地正色起来：“老头子这次，特地要我大老远的回国，是不是有什么新任务？”

“据说是保护一个美女总裁。”颜怡月道，“不过具体情况，我也不太清楚。”

“对你都保密了？”叶乘风皱了皱眉，最终道，“这事儿，恐怕不简单。”

“是的，老头子……啊呸，老首长说，这对叶首长而言，恐怕是有史以来最艰巨的一个任务。”

叶乘风忽然虚指点了点颜怡月，笑眯眯道：“我命令你，立刻给我一点儿好处，不然铁定告你一状。”

而心下，却是腹诽不已：“要不是你左一句老头子，右一句老头子，老娘能被你带坏？”

叶乘风“啪”地一声，直接在颜怡月那浑圆翘臀拍了一下，惹得颜怡月娇羞地跳了起来，脸色越来越红，犹如煮熟的螃蟹。

“首长太坏了，我会告你骚扰女部下。”

“你要是去告了，回头铁定吃掉你。”

叶乘风坏笑一声，见此时的机场贵宾停车区，只有一辆挂着军牌的新路虎揽胜，而且还是巅峰创世加长版，伊帕内玛沙滩金的颜色。

于是，他笑着伸手道：“钥匙给我吧，老头子居然知道我的胃口，看样子这辆快四百万的新揽胜，是要送给我的节奏。”

“叶首长！这其实……是……是我们隐凤组的车。”

颜怡月把车钥匙递给叶乘风后，都不敢去看他了。

这事儿她知道，老首长虽然特地给叶乘风配了辆回国任务的专用车，但其实……是一辆皮卡，而且还不知道是几手货。

她废了好大劲儿，才从旧车市场以4800块的价格淘来的，手动档！

要是叶乘风知道，铁定得发飙，所以她眼下不敢说。

叶乘风上车后，才忽然想起一事，于是忙对那另外的两名隐凤组成员道：“你们去找一个叫杨国东的空警，把我在飞机上打晕的那几个真理教恐怖分子，秘密处理下。”

说完，叶乘风便美滋滋地欣赏了一下这辆新路虎揽胜的内饰，赞口不绝。

随即，他等颜怡月上车后，便发动车子，一踩油门冲出了机场的贵宾停车区。

到了非高速公路上的时候，叶乘风更是以接近两百码的速度狂飙，在那密集的车流中不断超车。

别说副驾驶位的颜怡月了，就是路上其他被超的车辆主人，也都心惊胆颤。

不过，好在叶乘风驾车技术非常厉害，反应也超快，一路下来算是有惊无险。

于是，到了那家五星级酒店下车后，颜怡月第一时间接过了叶乘风手中的钥匙，暗暗决定以后不给这家伙开了。

否则，什么超速闯红灯的罚单，都得落到她的头上。

约莫五分钟左右，颜怡月就带着叶乘风，来到了酒店的一间总统套房。

叶乘风一开门，便是冲口喊道：“什么事情搞不定，居然要我大老远的特地回国？”
content_en:
"Go ahead, don't alert the police or the media. At the same time, be careful to delete the surveillance videos and calm the emotions of the passengers on the plane. After the plane lands, someone will take away those truth cult terrorists."

Ye Chengfeng put the ID back into his pocket and waved his hand.

In about twenty minutes, the plane landed smoothly at China Jingcheng International Airport.

Under normal circumstances, if a terrorist hijacking occurs, countless reporters and police will be attracted regardless of whether the plane lands safely or not.

But this time, because of Ye Chengfeng's order, all news was blocked, and it was as calm as if nothing had happened.

"Thank you for today. My name is Dongfang Xue. May I ask my benefactor's surname?"

When Ye Chengfeng stepped off the plane, a heavenly voice came to him, accompanied by a refreshing fragrance.

Ye Chengfeng looked back and saw a pair of slender legs wrapped in black stockings, exuding magic that made people want to reach out and touch them.

Besides the iceberg beauty who sat next to him before, who else had such seductive legs?

When Ye Chengfeng heard the words Dongfang Xue, the bright smile on his face suddenly froze, and his palms clenched into fists unconsciously.

But soon, he relaxed his fists, put on his smile again, and strode away.

In the VIP lounge of the airport, Ye Chengfeng saw three women wearing red berets, black vests and light gray camouflage hot pants.

Just stop there and do nothing, and you will see a beautiful scenery.

Especially those long and beautiful legs with white flowers are even more charming and arousing people's imagination.

When Ye Chengfeng approached, the three hot-figured women all saluted, looking very respectful.

Ye Chengfeng looked around for a while, then said with some dissatisfaction.

The woman at the head sweated secretly, thinking that in all of China, perhaps only Chief Ye dared to call the person in charge of China's Hidden Dragon and Hidden Phoenix an old man, right?

Although the old man is indeed quite old and has white hair, his actual power is second only to the supreme leader of China.

Sometimes, China's top leaders even have to listen to his advice with an open mind.

Such an awesome person was actually called an old man by Ye Chengfeng unceremoniously!

Ye Chengfeng didn't see the person he wanted to see right away, so he couldn't help but muttered in frustration: "This old man's official job is getting better and better. Why is the safety on the plane so bad? I encountered a hijacking as soon as I returned home. This meeting was specifically held in a hotel. What kind of plane are they on? Do you want these three pretty girls from the Yinfeng Group to spend the night with me?"

Thinking of something funny, Ye Chengfeng couldn't help but put his arms around the sexy waist of the leading woman, moved his hands down, pinched her round buttocks and said: "Xiao Yueyue, the food has been so good recently, right? Your butt is a lot bigger. It wasn't that big last time in Los Angeles."

The hot woman named Xiao Yueyue blushed, but she did not dare to break away from Ye Chengfeng's embrace: "My name is Yan Yiyue, not Xiao Yueyue. Also, your hands...can't you do this? It's embarrassing to be seen by others."

"Uh, sorry, next time I'll find a place where no one can see me."

Yan Yiyue made a long sound and tapped her feet lightly, irritated.

Ye Chengfeng suddenly became serious: "The old man asked me to come all the way back to China this time. Does he have any new tasks?"

"It is said that he is protecting a beautiful CEO." Yan Yiyue said, "But I don't know the specific situation."

"Kept it a secret from you?" Ye Chengfeng frowned and finally said, "I'm afraid this matter is not simple."

"Yes, old man...ah, the old chief said, for Chief Ye, this is probably the most difficult task in history."

Ye Chengfeng suddenly pointed at Yan Yiyue and said with a smile: "I order you to give me some benefits immediately, otherwise I will definitely sue you."

But in my heart, I was slandering: "If you hadn't said an old man to the left and an old man to the right, how could I have been led astray by you?"

Ye Chengfeng made a "pop" sound and slapped Yan Yiyue's round buttocks, causing Yan Yiyue to jump up shyly, her face getting redder and redder, like a cooked crab.

"Chief, you are too bad. I will sue you for harassing your female subordinates."

"If you file a complaint, I will definitely eat you later."

Ye Chengfeng smirked and saw that in the VIP parking area of the airport at this time, there was only a new Range Rover with military plates, and it was also the extended version of the Peak Genesis in Ipanema Beach Gold color.

So, he smiled and stretched out his hand and said: "Give me the key. The old man actually knows my appetite. It seems that this new Range Rover, worth almost 4 million, is going to be given to me."

"Chief Ye! This is actually... the car of our Yinfeng group."

After Yan Yiyue handed the car keys to Ye Chengfeng, she didn't dare to look at him.

She knew this. Although the old chief had specially equipped Ye Chengfeng with a special vehicle for his return mission, in fact... it was a pickup truck, and she didn't know what it was.

After a lot of effort, she bought it from the used car market for 4,800 yuan, a manual transmission!

If Ye Chengfeng knew about it, he would definitely go crazy, so she didn't dare to say anything now.

After Ye Chengfeng got in the car, he suddenly remembered something, so he hurriedly said to the other two members of the Hidden Phoenix Group: "You go find an air police officer named Yang Guodong and secretly deal with the truth cult terrorists I knocked unconscious on the plane."

After saying that, Ye Chengfeng admired the interior of this new Range Rover and praised it endlessly.

Immediately, he waited for Yan Yiyue to get in the car, started the car, stepped on the accelerator and rushed out of the VIP parking area of ​​the airport.

When he arrived on the off-highway, Ye Chengfeng drove at a speed of nearly 200 yards, constantly overtaking other cars in the dense traffic.

Not to mention Yan Yiyue in the passenger seat, even the owners of other vehicles being passed on the road were frightened.

However, fortunately, Ye Chengfeng's driving skills are very good and his reactions are super fast, so there were no accidents along the way.

So, after getting off the car at the five-star hotel, Yan Yiyue immediately took the key from Ye Chengfeng's hand and secretly decided not to open it to this guy in the future.

Otherwise, any ticket for speeding and running a red light would have to fall on her head.

In about five minutes, Yan Yiyue took Ye Chengfeng to a presidential suite in the hotel.

As soon as Ye Chengfeng opened the door, he shouted: "Why can't you handle something and you want me to go all the way back to China?"
